title: A direct sum devissage presents the module as the sum of the successive quotients
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a direct sum devissage of a module exhibits it as the direct sum of the successive quotients of the devissage (statement lines 20626-20631). The proof does not quote a structure theorem: it assembles the natural map from the direct sum using the inclusions provided by the devissage, gets surjectivity from the fact that each element appears at some stage, and proves injectivity by a transfinite induction pushing a vanishing sum into earlier and earlier stages (proof lines 20633-20670). The transfinite induction is the substance of the argument, and the author writes it out. H2.
